:::{#lem-wilks-std-gaussian}
#### Standardizing an approximately Gaussian estimate

Suppose the MLE $\hthml$ is approximately Gaussian with mean $\param_0$
and variance $\einf(\param_0)^{-1}$,
the inverse of the [expected information](#def-einf):
$\hthml \dsim \ndist{\param_0, \einf(\param_0)^{-1}}$.
Define $Z \eqdef \sqrt{\einf(\param_0)}\,(\hthml - \param_0)$.
Then $Z$ is approximately standard Gaussian,
so $Z^2$ is approximately $\chi^2_1$:

$$Z^2 \dsim \chi^2_1$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-wilks-std-gaussian, worked in @sol-wilks-std-gaussian.

:::
